title: "04 GAM Model"
author: "Varvara"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r main}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)


df_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "nonparametric_model_data.csv"))
df <- df_raw |>
  mutate(
    severe  = as.integer(severe),
    hour    = as.numeric(hour),
    speed_f = factor(speed_limit),
    day_type = factor(day_type)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(severe), !is.na(hour), !is.na(speed_limit))

cat("N після очищення:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Частка severe:", round(mean(df$severe) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("Рівні speed_limit:", levels(df$speed_f), "\n")


model_gam_space <- mgcv::gam(
  severe ~ speed_f +
    s(hour, bs = "cc", k = 12) +
    s(longitude, latitude, k = 50) +
    factor(rural) +
    factor(road_type) +
    factor(light_conditions) +
    factor(weather_conditions) +
    factor(road_surface_conditions) +
    day_type,
  family = binomial(),
  data   = df,
  method = "REML"
)

cat("\n=== GAM A (просторовий smooth) ===\n")
summary(model_gam_space)

if ("police_force" %in% names(df)) {
  model_gam_police <- mgcv::gam(
    severe ~ speed_f +
      s(hour, bs = "cc", k = 12) +
      factor(rural) +
      factor(road_type) +
      factor(light_conditions) +
      factor(weather_conditions) +
      factor(road_surface_conditions) +
      day_type +
      factor(police_force),
    family = binomial(),
    data   = df,
    method = "REML"
  )
  cat("\n=== GAM B (police_force) ===\n")
  summary(model_gam_police)
} else {
  cat("\npolice_force відсутній — GAM B пропущено\n")
  model_gam_police <- NULL
}

most_common <- function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]

newdata_speed <- tibble(
  speed_f                 = factor(levels(df$speed_f), levels = levels(df$speed_f)),
  hour                    = median(df$hour, na.rm = TRUE),
  longitude               = median(df$longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude                = median(df$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  rural                   = 0,
  road_type               = most_common(df$road_type),
  light_conditions        = most_common(df$light_conditions),
  weather_conditions      = most_common(df$weather_conditions),
  road_surface_conditions = most_common(df$road_surface_conditions),
  day_type                = factor("Weekday", levels = levels(df$day_type))
)

pred_speed <- predict(
  model_gam_space,
  newdata = newdata_speed,
  type    = "response",
  se.fit  = TRUE
)

newdata_speed <- newdata_speed |>
  mutate(
    pred  = as.numeric(drop(pred_speed$fit)),
    lower = as.numeric(pmax(drop(pred_speed$fit) - 1.96 * drop(pred_speed$se.fit), 0)),
    upper = as.numeric(pmin(drop(pred_speed$fit) + 1.96 * drop(pred_speed$se.fit), 1))
  )


p_speed <- ggplot(newdata_speed, aes(x = speed_f, y = pred)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(pred, accuracy = 0.1)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Передбачена ймовірність тяжкого ДТП за speed_limit (GAM A)",
    subtitle = "За інших рівних умов (медіанні значення контролів)",
    x        = "Speed limit (mph)",
    y        = "P(severe)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_speed)

ggsave(
  here("nonparametric", "outputs", "figures", "gam_speed_limit_predicted_probabilities.png"),
  plot = p_speed, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150
)

p_hour <- gratia::draw(model_gam_space, select = "s(hour)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Smooth ефект години доби — GAM A",
    subtitle = "Нелінійний вплив часу доби на log-odds тяжкого ДТП",
    x        = "Година доби",
    y        = "s(hour)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_hour)

ggsave(
  here("nonparametric", "outputs", "figures", "gam_hour_smooth.png"),
  plot = p_hour, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150
)

p_spatial <- gratia::draw(model_gam_space, select = "s(longitude,latitude)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Просторовий smooth — GAM A",
    subtitle = "Регіональні відмінності у тяжкості ДТП"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_spatial)

ggsave(
  here("nonparametric", "outputs", "figures", "gam_spatial_smooth.png"),
  plot = p_spatial, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 150
)

pred_vec  <- as.numeric(drop(pred_speed$fit))
lower_vec <- as.numeric(pmax(drop(pred_speed$fit) - 1.96 * drop(pred_speed$se.fit), 0))
upper_vec <- as.numeric(pmin(drop(pred_speed$fit) + 1.96 * drop(pred_speed$se.fit), 1))

gam_speed_predictions <- tibble(
  speed_limit    = levels(df$speed_f),
  predicted_prob = round(pred_vec, 4),
  ci_lower       = round(lower_vec, 4),
  ci_upper       = round(upper_vec, 4)
)

write_csv(
  gam_speed_predictions,
  here("nonparametric", "outputs", "tables", "gam_speed_limit_predictions.csv")
)

if (!is.null(model_gam_police)) {

  newdata_police <- newdata_speed |>
    mutate(police_force = most_common(df$police_force))

  pred_police <- predict(
    model_gam_police,
    newdata = newdata_police,
    type    = "response",
    se.fit  = TRUE
  )

  comparison <- tibble(
    speed_limit = levels(df$speed_f),
    pred_gam_a  = round(as.numeric(drop(pred_speed$fit)), 4),
    pred_gam_b  = round(as.numeric(drop(pred_police$fit)), 4),
    diff        = round(as.numeric(drop(pred_police$fit)) - as.numeric(drop(pred_speed$fit)), 4)
  )

  write_csv(
    comparison,
    here("nonparametric", "outputs", "tables", "gam_model_comparison.csv")
  )
  cat("\nЗбережено: gam_model_comparison.csv\n")
  print(comparison)

} else {
  cat("\nПорівняння пропущено — GAM B не побудовано\n")
}

saveRDS(model_gam_space,
        here("nonparametric", "outputs", "models", "model_gam_space.rds"))
cat("\nЗбережено: model_gam_space.rds\n")

if (!is.null(model_gam_police)) {
  saveRDS(model_gam_police,
          here("nonparametric", "outputs", "models", "model_gam_police.rds"))
  cat("Збережено: model_gam_police.rds\n")
}
```
